corrections.issue: A_4EQJ is a standard linear peptide (HIV-1 protease substrate, seq AETFYVDG); Asp8 has no covalent link to Tyr6. Its side chain (CG, OD1, OD2) is simply disordered in the crystal - only N, CA, C, O, CB are modelled in both poses. The original repair mis-handled this: (1) it omitted OD2 in both pose_01_fixed and pose_02_fixed, shipping an incomplete carboxylate (CG, OD1 only); (2) in pose_02_fixed it fabricated a covalent Asp.CG-Tyr.OH ester (a covale in both .cif and .sdf, with CG placed 1.51 A from Tyr.OH) from a distance-triggered link inference misfiring on the nearby disordered side chain; (3) meta.json recorded a spurious covalent_junctions 'ASP.OD2-TYR.OH' (OD2 exists in no shipped structure; the 1.42/0.5 A distances are non-physical) and an inconsistent incomplete_residues inventory (heavy_present 6 despite only 5 crystal atoms; missing_atoms [CG,OD1] omitting OD2).
corrections.fix: Regenerated pose_01_fixed and pose_02_fixed with a proper aspartate carboxylate: CG/OD1/OD2 placed at ideal CCD geometry on the frozen crystal N-CA-CB frame, chi1/chi2 chosen by steric optimisation against the frozen receptor and peptide, then refined by a restrained in-pocket energy minimisation (all crystal + receptor atoms frozen; only CG/OD1/OD2 mobile). Removed the fabricated Asp.CG-Tyr.OH bond. Both poses now sanitise to C36H48N6O12 with the carboxylate 3.3-4.0 A from Tyr6.OH (non-bonded). Corrected metadata: incomplete_residues ASP heavy_present 6->5 and missing_atoms [CG,OD1]->[CG,OD1,OD2]; removed covalent_junctions__pose_01 and __pose_02; fixed_geometry n_rebuilt 6->7 (added ASP OD2). Crystal atoms are byte-identical.
corrections.note: GLU3's rebuilt side chain (CD,CG,OE1,OE2) was produced by the original repair and is unchanged; only ASP8's atoms were regenerated. provenance.poses[].atoms (47) counts crystal atoms and is unchanged.
